name: Microsoft Fluent 2
licence: MIT for @fluentui/* code and tokens (github.com/microsoft/fluentui, LICENSE file; GitHub API reports NOASSERTION because of the file header only) and MIT for the system icon set. Segoe UI / Segoe UI Variable are Microsoft-licensed fonts, not redistributable: ship the system fallback stack instead. Brand/product-launch icons and Microsoft logos are not licensed.
bestFor: productivity and admin SaaS (Microsoft 365, Teams, Azure-portal-like consoles)
data-dense dashboards and forms with small 24/32/40 controls
products that must feel native on Windows and also work on web, iOS, Android
teams that need a complete light / dark / forced-colors theme from one brand ramp
avoidFor: expressive marketing or campaign sites (type ramp tops out at a 68px Display; no editorial voice)
consumer brands that need a strong own identity (the system is deliberately neutral and 'unmistakably Microsoft')
anything where a licensed Segoe UI is not available and system-font fallbacks would change the metrics

families: Segoe UI (web default; fallback 'Segoe UI Web (West European)', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif)
Segoe UI Variable (Windows), SF Pro (macOS, iOS), Roboto (Android) per platform
typography.notes: Source: packages/tokens/src/global/{fonts,typographyStyles}.ts (code is authoritative). Primitive sizes: fontSizeBase100..600 = 10,12,14,16,20,24 and fontSizeHero700..1000 = 28,32,40,68; lineHeights 14,16,20,22,28,32 and 36,40,52,92. Body default is 14/20 (small for a modern marketing site). Weights are 400/500/600/700; headings are semibold 600 not bold. No letter-spacing tokens exist, so trackingEm 0 means 'none specified', not a measured value. fluent2.microsoft.design/typography lists Subtitle 1 as 20/26 but code has lineHeightBase500 = 28px: flagged in the note. Sentence case only; docs forbid all caps for attention. Platform ramps differ (iOS/Android/macOS use pt/sp and different sizes); the web ramp above is the one to bind a web project to.

neutrals.note: Grey ramp steps 2..98 in steps of 2 plus 99; light theme uses grey 14 (#242424) as primary text, 98/96/94/92 as the four background layers, 82 as default stroke, 88 as subtle stroke. Alpha ramps whiteAlpha/blackAlpha 5,10,20..90 plus grey10/12/14Alpha.

accents.note: A theme is built from ONE 16-step brand ramp (keys 10,20,...,160) via createLightTheme(brand) / createDarkTheme(brand). Light uses brand 80 as rest, 70 hover, 40 pressed (button), 60 selected; dark swaps to 70 rest, 80 hover, 40 pressed for filled brand backgrounds and 100/110 for brand text. Note: comments in generated alias files still show the legacy #0078d4 for brand 80; the current brandWeb ramp has brand 80 = #0f6cbd.

semantic.personaPaletteNote: 28 persona colours (darkRed ... anchor) each ship Background2/Foreground2/BorderActive tokens; status colours ship Background1-3, Foreground1-3, Border1-2, BorderActive. Every colour ramp has 12 stops: shade50..shade10 (5), primary, tint10..tint60 (6).

color.darkMode: Separate generated alias set (darkColor.ts), not an inversion of light: Background1 #292929 (grey16), Background2 #1f1f1f, Background3 #141414, Background4 #0a0a0a, Background5 #000, card #333333; Foreground1 #fff, Foreground2 grey84 #d6d6d6, Foreground3 grey68 #adadad; stroke1 grey40 #666666, stroke2 grey32 #525252; brand filled bg uses brand70 hover brand80; brand text/link uses brand100/110; shadows double in opacity (ambient 0.24, key 0.28 vs 0.12/0.14 light); scrim 0.5 vs 0.4. A third theme, high contrast, maps every token to CSS system colours (Canvas, ButtonText, Highlight, GrayText) and components add forced-colors rules. Shared (status/persona) colours shift saturation and brightness in dark.
color.contrastNotes: Computed 2026-10-08: foreground1 #242424 on white 15.5:1; fg2 #424242 10.1:1; fg3 #616161 6.2:1; fg4 #707070 4.95:1 (smallest passing text step); brand80 #0f6cbd on white 5.38:1 and white on brand80 5.38:1; default stroke1 #d1d1d1 is only 1.53:1 against white so Fluent adds colorNeutralStrokeAccessible (#616161, 6.19:1) and uses it for the input bottom border and checkbox/radio outlines; disabled foreground #bdbdbd 1.88:1 (exempt). Docs: 4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text (>=18.5px bold or 24px) and non-text; focus indicator is a two-colour stroke (Focus1 white + Focus2 black) so it works on any surface.

spacing.base: 4px (design page: 'base unit is 4px'; 2, 6, 10 exist only to fit icon padding)

radius.rule: Code tokens: None 0, Small 2, Medium 4 (default for buttons, inputs, tooltips, menus), Large 6, XLarge 8 (dialogs), 2XL 12, 3XL 16, 4XL 24, 5XL 32, 6XL 40, Circular 10000. The design page lists Large=8 and X-Large=12 (differs from code by one step): code wins for implementation. Rule from docs: shapes under 32px use 2px; rectangles default 4px; no rounding on edge-to-edge surfaces (nav bars, tab bars) or between joined parts (split button); pills for slider tracks / toggles / tags; circle for people; beak for callouts. Card radius follows size: small 2, medium 4, large 6.

shadows: light ambient rgba(0,0,0,.12) key rgba(0,0,0,.14); Lighter .06/.07; Darker .20/.24
brand shadows ambient .30 key .25 for coloured surfaces (never use the neutral ramp on colour)
depth.borders: 1px solid colorNeutralStroke1 (#d1d1d1 light) is the default control border; strokeWidthThin 1, Thick 2, Thicker 3, Thickest 4. Cards at rest use shadow2 plus a 1px stroke; hover lifts to shadow4/shadow8. Dialog surface radius 8px, shadow64, 24px padding, max-width 600px. Menu popover shadow16, radius 4, padding 4. Tooltip uses filter drop-shadow 0 0 2px ambient + 0 4px 8px key. Focus is drawn as a 2px stroke Focus2 (black) with a 1px inset ring, not as a glow.
depth.blur: Materials: Solid (default), Acrylic (semi-transparent frosted, only for transient light-dismiss surfaces such as menus and popovers), Mica (opaque, desktop-tinted, window base on Windows), Smoke (translucent black scrim behind modals; BlackAlpha 40% light, 50% dark). Numeric blur and tint values are not published on the design site (they defer to Windows material docs): unknown.

motion.notes: Duration tokens: UltraFast 50, Faster 100, Fast 150, Normal 200, Gentle 250, Slow 300, Slower 400, UltraSlow 500. Button colour/border transitions use Faster (100ms) + curveEasyEase; Switch uses Normal (200ms) + EasyEase; every transition drops to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion. Enter = decelerate curves, exit = accelerate curves. Patterns on the design site: enter/exit, elevation, top-level (quick fade, do not slide big surfaces), container transform; staggering preferred over simultaneous. react-motion-components-preview ships Fade, Scale, Slide, Collapse, Blur, Rotate, Stagger each with Snappy/Relaxed variants.

list: button (secondary, primary, outline, subtle, transparent; rounded, circular, square; small, medium, large; icon-only)
components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Very complete at token level: every interactive foreground/background/stroke has Rest, Hover, Pressed, Selected variants plus Disabled; brand-compound variants for checkable controls; Inverted and Static variants for use on colour; subtle (transparent) variant family for toolbar-like controls. Component code implements default, hover, active (hover:active), focus-visible (custom focus indicator via tabster), disabled and forced-colors for button, input, checkbox, switch, tabs, card (interactive card has hover/pressed/selected/disabled). Size matrix is 3 sizes x appearances. Error/validation lives in Field (validationState). Count is of stable packages in packages/react-components as of master (approximate: counted by package directory, previews excluded).

tokenArchitecture: Three layers. (1) Global tokens: raw palette (grey 2..99, brand 10..160, 28 persona + 7 status ramps of 13 stops, alpha ramps) and primitive scales (fontSizeBase100.., spacing, borderRadius, strokeWidth, duration, curve). (2) Alias tokens: 184 semantic colour tokens (counted in lightColor.ts and darkColor.ts) named color{Neutral|Brand|CompoundBrand|Subtle|Transparent|Palette|Status}{Foreground|Background|Stroke}{n}{Hover|Pressed|Selected|Disabled} plus shadow2..64 and typography styles; generated by a token pipeline ('DO NOT EDIT' files lightColor.ts / darkColor.ts / highContrastColor.ts). (3) Component styles (Griffel makeStyles/makeResetStyles) consume only alias tokens as CSS variables on FluentProvider. A theme object = createLightTheme(brandRamp) / createDarkTheme(brandRamp); swapping the 16-hex brand ramp rebrands everything. Numbered suffixes (Foreground1/2/3, Background1..8, Stroke1..4) are ranked by prominence, not by lightness.
distinctiveness: The numbered neutral ladders (Background1-8, Foreground1-4, Stroke1-4) with Hover/Pressed/Selected siblings; 14px/20px body with semibold (not bold) headings in Segoe UI; 4px default radius, 8px dialogs; hairline strokes plus two-layer ambient+key shadows with the blur number in the token name; Smoke/Acrylic/Mica material vocabulary; one 16-step brand ramp per product; strong forced-colors story. Reads as 'Office/Teams/Azure': flat, neutral, rectangular.
weaknesses: Default stroke #d1d1d1 is 1.53:1; reliance on the Accessible stroke tokens must be enforced by hand
docs and code disagree (Subtitle1 line-height 26 vs 28; radius Large 8 vs 6) and generated files still comment old brand hex
body default 14px is below the 16px web norm and display tops at 68px: weak for marketing/editorial
Segoe UI cannot be shipped, so metrics drift on non-Windows systems
very large token surface (hundreds of colour aliases) for little visual variety; the system is not designed to carry a distinctive brand
design-site motion page gives no numbers; real values live only in code
takeaways: Name shadows by blur radius and build each from an ambient + key pair, with a documented darker/lighter pair for dark mode and a separate brand shadow for coloured surfaces
Ship Rest/Hover/Pressed/Selected/Disabled as a fixed state vector for every colour role, so no component invents a state colour
Provide an 'accessible stroke' token distinct from the decorative stroke; decorative borders may be low-contrast but control boundaries must be >=3:1
Derive a whole light/dark/high-contrast theme from one 16-step brand ramp; the ramp index (80 rest, 70 hover, 40 pressed) is the contract
Use a single 3-size control ladder (24/32/40) with one radius (4px) so mixed components always align on a baseline grid
Respect reduced motion at the token level (0.01ms) rather than per animation
Focus ring as two contrasting strokes (white + black) that works on any background
